scope: Synthetic first-level contrast NIfTI export, fmrigds import and group arithmetic; no study data

environment.installation: Three pinned packages compiled/installed into an isolated local library; other dependencies from existing library

checks: FLOAT32 beta/SE maps match fitted contrasts
Sparse spatial positions and outside-mask zeros
Explicit unsorted subject IDs and JSON contrast order preserved
Distinct SEs across contrasts; intentionally swapped SE volumes rejected by value comparison
Fixed-pooling effect and SE agree with independent inverse-variance arithmetic
Group OLS mean and SE agree with independent mean/sd/sqrt(n)
Group OLS contributing N and residual df
Derived coverage fixture: real zero retained, NA omitted with samplewise N
probe.expected_warning: The partial-coverage fixture reports one sample with non-finite subjects.

api_findings: by_stat fourth axis indexes contrasts; by_contrast fourth axis indexes statistics
nifti_source accepts SE; reducers derive variance as SE squared
Explicit subjects bypass filename pairing checks
NIfTI importer does not compare all input affines
Default import mask covers all grid voxels
fmrigds main at this pin lacks zero_is_missing and group threshold pools subject and contrast axes
fmrireg format=gds packages regressor-level assays at this pin
limits: Not a full R package test suite or R CMD check
Not a complete dependency lock or installed cluster verification
No real-data registration, noise calibration, group inference qualification or behavioral Codex/Claude evaluation
review: Independent statistical/API review found a symmetric-SE fixture weakness; replaced opposite contrasts with non-symmetric contrasts and verified deliberate SE swap detection.
